description:
DeFi protocol treasury holdings -- how much a protocol holds in its own treasury, split into its own token, stablecoins, majors and others, largest treasury first. Pass protocol (name, slug or CoinGecko id; the '(treasury)' suffix is optional) or symbol to look one up. Results are one page: limit 1-100 (default 25), offset 0-10000; pass next_offset to get the next page. Use it when the user asks about protocol treasuries, DAO holdings or protocol-owned liquidity.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

protocol.description: Protocol or token name, DefiLlama slug or CoinGecko id, case-insensitive exact match.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_treasuries
